name: 4d-plugin-curl
description: Windows x64 dependency set for the 4D cURL plugin. Produces the static libraries committed to lib\64.
$comment-libs: libproxy and libiconv are not curl dependencies. The plugin includes proxy.h and iconv.h directly: libproxy backs the AUTOPROXY option, libiconv the FTP encoding conversion. libunistring reaches the link line only as a dependency of libidn2.
$comment-openssl: The override is redundant at the baseline below, which already carries 3.6.3. It is kept as an explicit floor so a baseline bump cannot move OpenSSL without someone editing this line. OpenSSL 3.6 is end-of-life on 2026-11-01 - see build.md.

dependencies.$comment: Feature list derived from cURL_VersionInfo on the shipping build, not guessed. default-features is false on purpose: curl's defaults are [non-http, ssl], and 'ssl' resolves to Schannel on Windows unless http3 is also set. The shipping build reports a bare OpenSSL ssl_version with MULTI_SSL clear, so Schannel is not in it and must not be added. Omitting the defaults also keeps websockets, psl, gsasl, httpsrr and c-ares out, matching the build this replaces in every case except c-ares, which is removed deliberately - see build.md.
dependencies.name: curl
